title: Phrasal verbs 3
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. b1_phrasal_1 (36) and b1_phrasal_2 (36) own 72 phrasal verbs between them, plus b1_phrasal_verbs as an older overlapping set, so the sweep mattered — only get over came back already taught out of 42 candidates, but that is because the candidate list was built AGAINST the two b1 banks rather than from scratch. Everything here is new. The unit is organised by JOB rather than alphabetically or by particle, which is the difference from b1: understanding and finding out (come across, come up with, get across, figure out, point out, take in, make out, go over), trouble and coping (break down, break into, break out, get away with, get by, fall through, fall behind, cut back on, keep up with), and change and effort (bring about, turn into, take up, put forward, set out, pull off, make up for, live up to, stand out, carry out). C57 card 0 recaps Phrasal verbs 1 and 2. C49 all 36 across three boards of 12. In place of a Build-the-family card this unit has THE PARTICLE CARRIES THE MEANING, which is the real equivalent for a phrasal set: out = to the end or into view, up = finished or raised, through = all the way, back = returning or reducing. USE PROMPTS ARE ALL IN BASE FORM (after a modal or *to*), because the rewrite check swaps in the LEMMA verbatim — a past-tense answer would never reconstruct from *come across*. That is a phrasal-specific trap and it shaped every one of the twelve Use items.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: Phrasal verbs 1 and 2 gave you seventy-two of them — turn on, throw away, wake up, give up, sort out, deal with, carry on, put up with, look after, catch up, end up. Those come back in this unit's sentences. What is new here is the layer that sounds natural rather than merely correct: the ones a B2 speaker understands but never produces.
cards.note_cz: Phrasal verbs 1 a 2 ti daly sedmdesát dva — turn on, throw away, wake up, give up, sort out, deal with, carry on, put up with, look after, catch up, end up. Vracejí se ve větách. Nové je tu to, co zní přirozeně, ne jen správně: ty, kterým B2 mluvčí rozumí, ale sám je nepoužije.

cards.title: The particle carries the meaning
points: The particle is not decoration. It does most of the work.
Learn the particle and a whole group becomes easier to guess.

rows: to the end, or into view
